corrections.reason: The claim asserted that two routes are 'both reachable without login' while its own note records that neither was exercised, so that property was inferred rather than observed, contrary to protocol section 5. It also asserted properties of two pages that have their own URLs while citing only the portal root, which is the general-site reference protocol section 7 forbids as a specific citation. Narrowed to what the cited page directly shows, which leaves the claim a true observation at Grade B rather than requiring a downgrade.
